name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-10-23, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.03 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
